values.heading: New & Used Inventory, Financing, And Fleet Solutions
values.text:
Winslow-Gerolamy Motors Limited offers a full selection of new and pre-owned International trucks, supporting owner-operators and fleets across Central Ontario.

As a family-owned International dealership since 1952, we provide reliable truck solutions backed by industry experience, strong manufacturer relationships, and full-service support.
